location_address: 7001 Shrimp Rd Dock A Slip #32 Stock Island, FL US 33040
description:
A three-hour private eco charter through the Great White Heron and Key West National Wildlife Refuges — federally protected zones surrounding the Lower Keys and home to some of Florida’s most untouched marine habitat. Your USCG-licensed captain narrates as you go: mangrove forests, seagrass flats, bird rookeries, the occasional manatee, and the reef patches where green sea turtles graze. Best booked early morning or late afternoon when wildlife is most active.

Quick facts: 

• 3 hrs $995 
• Private (your group only) 
• USCG-licensed captain 
• Perry Hotel & Marina 
• Fuel + safety gear included

what_is_included_items.value: Two bean bag chairs  (upon request at the dock)

what_is_not_included_items.value: Tipping the Captain and Crew: If you are satisfied, the minimum tip is typically not less than 20%.

itinerary:
Departure – Perry Hotel & Marina
Meet at Dock A, Slip #32. After a safety briefing, we cruise toward protected backcountry waters.

Mangrove Exploration
Navigate through calm mangrove-lined channels and shallow flats. Learn about their critical role as nurseries for marine life and protection against coastal erosion.

Wildlife Observation
Slow cruising through National Wildlife Refuge waters for dolphin sightings, sea turtles, rays, shorebirds, osprey, and pelicans.

Shallow Water Stop (Conditions Permitting)
Optional stop in a quiet cove or sandbar area to explore shallow waters and observe marine life up close.

Return Cruise
Relax on the scenic ride back to the marina.

special_requirements:
• Primary booking party must be 21 years or older.
• Children under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
• Guests must be able to board the vessel independently or with minimal assistance.
• Bareboat charters (7–8 passengers) require a designated renter 21+ to complete the Bareboat Agreement.
• Guests participating in water activities must be comfortable around water.
restrictions:
• Wildlife encounters cannot be guaranteed.
• Not recommended for guests with significant mobility limitations due to vessel access.
• Excessive intoxication may result in denial of boarding or early termination without refund.
• Smoking or vaping is not permitted inside the cabin.
• Open flames are not permitted onboard.

This tour prioritizes conservation and protected habitat areas; disruptive behavior will not be permitted.
extras: - Fuel is extra for trips with over six passengers at $35/hour
disclaimers:
